mapper.insert: INSERT INTO message (message_id, conversation_id, sender_id, content, context_product_id, read_at, created_at) VALUES (#{messageId}, #{conversationId}, #{senderId}, #{content}, #{contextProductId}, NULL, #{createdAt})
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM message WHERE conversation_id = #{conversationId}
mapper.update: UPDATE message SET read_at = #{readAt} WHERE conversation_id = #{conversationId} AND sender_id != #{userId} AND read_at IS NULL
